@BigDoggge @v44n2 @elonmusk @ChainLinkGod @PeterMcCormack If a currency has 1 million people with one coin, and 9 people with 1 million coins each, then “big community” does not equal decentralization.

If you want to invest in “vibe” that’s totally fine, but it’s anti The People to spread disinformation about Dogecoin’s centralization.

@profgalloway @elonmusk @jchatterleyCNN @CNN Elon is doing incredible damage to his cult of personality. He burned bridges with Bitcoin holders. If he produces his own coin he’ll burn bridges with Dogecoin holders. Many of these people likely to be Tesla shareholders. Is another $100b worth the vilification it’d bring him?

@rationalwalk @elonmusk Elon promoted Bitcoin, then said it’s bad for the environment and lost support of Bitcoiners. He also promoted Dogecoin, and most people who jumped in after that got rekt.
